title: Graphiks WebGPU Suite — Benchmarks
description: Two portable workloads measure this browser's WebGPU implementation: writing buffers through the queue, and encoding and submitting a compute load.
protocol: Protocol foundations-v1. The standard and ci profiles run the same workloads at the same sizes and batch sizes; only the warm-ups and the number of retained samples change.
timing: Each sample stores two durations read from the same monotonic clock: the synchronous GPU calls, submission included for compute, and the wait until queue.onSubmittedWorkDone() resolves. Preparing resources, creating buffers and reading results back stay outside the window. These are CPU and completion observations, not pure GPU time, and they depend on the runtime and the machine.
lowResolution: Low resolution: the clock returned zero for some cpuIssueMs samples.
unavailable: WebGPU is not available in this browser; no benchmark can run.
cancelled: Campaign cancelled. The previous result, if any, stays displayed and is not replaced.
notPublished: This local result does not replace any published report.
